description: 暖白、品牌色、叙事大图和呼吸感留白，适合品牌、文化与年度回顾

identity.composition: 16:9 暖白画布；大字叙事与几何图像块错位编排，保持明显呼吸感。
identity.hierarchy: 先建立情绪与主题，再用人物、场景和信号解释品牌判断，最后留下邀请。
identity.image_treatment: 使用大面积裁切、暖色块和低饱和图像窗口，图片承担叙事而非装饰。
identity.module_language: 细线、温和色块、编辑式分栏和不完全对称的视觉拼贴。
identity.chart_evidence: 数据使用大数字、短标签和少量结构图，不让图表破坏叙事节奏。
identity.motion: 以淡入、轻移和画面焦点变化为主；每一步只推进一个情绪或判断节点。

canvas.density: low to medium, one statement plus 1-3 narrative modules

components.chart: Prefer a single visual relationship, large value or short comparison over dense dashboards.
components.table: Convert tables into editorial rows with generous leading and clear narrative labels.
components.evidence_card: Pair a real image or quote with one sentence that states why it matters.
components.image: Use warm crops, visible texture and deliberate overlap; do not replace real source imagery with decoration.

motion.stagger: one image or narrative block per data-step
